Hi I'm cozyyrose and this is my first mod!
It's compatible with 1.6.

I hope you like it!
Read on for more info! ♥

[size=6]Requirements:[/size]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense
[/url]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI﻿[/url]﻿

[size=6]How to Install:[/size]
- Have Fashion Sense and SMAPI installed.
- Download the mod and unzip.
- Copy unzipped folder into your Mods folder.
- Play!

[size=6]How to Use:[/size]
- Buy the hand mirror from Pierre's. (Fashion Sense)
- Use that to change to any of the hairstyles.
- Done!

[size=6]More Info:[/size]
I'm a big Stardew Valley fan, specifically I love modded
Stardew Valley. I figured since I already knew how to do
pixel art, I would try my hand at making a hair mod.
All the hairs are drawn by me.
Hope you enjoy!

[size=6]Extra Stuff:[/size]
- Check the permissions drop down above for info on that.
- But in general, please don't reupload or sell any of my mods.
- Let me know if you encounter any bugs or errors.
